recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed in current FHIR core source for FHIR-30085 unless a future work group decision changes which datatypes are considered bindable.
issue_request: FHIR-30085 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking that ElementDefinition eld-11 allow bindings on Duration, after an Encounter.length binding was rejected even though Duration inherits Quantity's bindable-unit behavior.
initial_application: Jira comments identify R4B and R5 pull requests, and git history contains Apply FHIR-30085 commits 842dd13bae and 2a473942da that added Duration to eld-11 in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active datatype, normative artifact, and eld abbreviation, confirming build scope. Later FHIR-21622 work updated the same invariant to exempt non-FHIR/absolute type codes and changed the human wording to "if using FHIR-defined types" while preserving Duration. A Zulip tooling thread corroborates the original validator report, and no conflicting Confluence or Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current eld-11 row already includes Duration in both the FHIRPath expression and XPath expression, alongside the later custom-type allowance.

related_jiras.note: Updated the same eld-11 invariant to exempt non-FHIR/absolute type codes; it explains the current wording and preserves the FHIR-30085 Duration allowance.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction reporting that eld-11 rejected a binding on Encounter.length because Duration was not treated as bindable.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final issue request: eld-11 should allow Duration wherever bindings are otherwise valid.

evidence_items.summary: The current eld-11 row allows bindings when type.code is empty, non-FHIR/absolute, or one of code, Coding, CodeableConcept, Quantity, string, uri, or Duration.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current source already includes Duration in both the FHIRPath and XPath invariant forms.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinition is listed as an active datatype, marked normative, and mapped to the eld abbreviation.
evidence_items.learned: The inspected ElementDefinition spreadsheet is in current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: The Apply FHIR-30085 commits added Duration to eld-11 in source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira-requested change was explicitly applied before this audit.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-21622 updated eld-11 to skip non-FHIR datatypes and changed the human wording, while retaining Duration in the allowed type list.
evidence_items.learned: Later same-invariant work explains the current wording and does not supersede the Duration allowance.

evidence_items.summary: The December 2020 thread reports the same Encounter.length Duration binding validator error later captured in FHIR-30085.
evidence_items.learned: The community discussion corroborates the Jira problem statement and does not suggest a different resolution.
